approval_statement: I approve these D3 tolerances as operational FAIL thresholds, not validated equivalence margins, and the joint global alpha, the family alpha allocation and the family roles, for this audit. I fixed them before examining any D3 statistic of a confirmatory family on the audited data, and data_examined_before_approval records what was examined before approval.
data_examined_before_approval: Examined before this record was approved, on canonical instance 29cd55c91cb27686f0d9e3be82a37e7965694d3cc1363793638bc554bb641a43 unless stated otherwise. (1) The D0 canonical manifest, including the per-partition label counts (positive/negative: train 5,002,577/4,997,423; validation 499,892/500,108; test 499,351/500,649). These counts are R1's complete sufficient statistic, so R1's estimates, bounds and category were computable before approval; R1 is therefore exploratory and non-gating in this record. The same counts fix the class-stratum sizes used by R2, B, C, D and E, whose statistics depend on feature bits that were not examined. (2) The D1 certificate (PASS) and the D2 certificates A, B and C (each INCONCLUSIVE with no failures; warnings only for the radius-8 near-duplicate components), including their descriptive within- and cross-partition row-pair TVD values; these are D2 row-pair statistics, not D3 feature-pair statistics. (3) Method-validity calibration evidence on synthetic data only (the superseded runs d3_method_validity_20261022_976983a3, _6d81cf20 and _00b48038, and the run that binds this record), including S4/S5 design-resolution figures, which depend only on sample sizes and alphas. (4) Two blinded D3 integration runs on this instance under an earlier engine version (run 6601b309567e4758ab458df55895ce45, seal 2803b0db8e0e2f5e7469f9b1b7eb664db2cfb275ffcbf57abe199b24f28a4e90; run 1c04fe4cfcf5408aaee1fdb2f8da19e2, seal 0f01e61f4fb0824dc95a1d41a2ad10cc50404f0b808d7dd9b07c5981b09436fb). Each computed the complete D3 audit in memory with every tolerance undeclared; their certificates record only provenance, design, class counts, family sizes, alphas and the seal hash. No D3 effect, bound, p-value, category or outcome from them was displayed or recorded. (5) The earlier legacy-method Gohr D3 results in audit/dataset/evidence/d3/ were examined before approval by the drafting assistant (on 2026-10-22) and by the approver: the Gohr distribution-consistency audit with outcome PASS and its underlying statistics (d3_gohr_distribution_consistency_10000000_1000000_1000000_5r.json), and the separate DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY report (d3_gohr_10000000_1000000_1000000_5r.json). They concern Gohr's five-round Speck dataset (gohr-speck, num_rounds 5) and the legacy D3 method, not this instance or any AutoND D3 statistic or outcome. The Gohr PASS does not validate this record's thresholds, alphas, family roles or statistical design. (6) The autond_ii_v2 accuracy margin from which the thresholds are derived. Apart from R1 as stated in (1), no D3 statistic computed from this instance's features has been examined. This plan was fixed after D0, D1 and D2 had been run on this instance; it is not a preregistration made before the data existed.

tolerance_justification.class_conditional_bit: OPERATIONAL FAIL THRESHOLD, not a validated equivalence margin; no PASS or equivalence claim is made at it. Value 2m, where m = MARGIN_FRACTION x (0.5144 - 0.5) = 0.00144 (audit.targets.autond.preregistrations.autond_ii_v2.equivalence_margin, frozen in commit fc46c57 on 2026-10-16, before this instance existed). That margin was approved for checkpoint-accuracy replication; reusing it for D3 is a convention, not a D3-validated criterion. R2 checks each class-conditional bit marginal against the generator's exact reference 1/2, one bit in one class of one partition at a time; it is a check of conformity to the generator. It does NOT bound a label shortcut on its own: if the two classes deviate in opposite directions by up to 2m each, a single-bit classifier gains up to 2m. The cross-class shortcut is bounded only by family D. Design resolution at per-hypothesis alpha 0.001/384: 0.00105 (train), 0.00332 (validation/test). The upper bound cannot fall below 2m on validation/test, so a FAIL screen is the only decision available; FAIL requires a lower bound above 2m.
tolerance_justification.class_ratio: OPERATIONAL FAIL THRESHOLD, not a validated equivalence margin; no PASS or equivalence claim is made at it. Value m, where m = MARGIN_FRACTION x (0.5144 - 0.5) = 0.00144 (audit.targets.autond.preregistrations.autond_ii_v2.equivalence_margin, frozen in commit fc46c57 on 2026-10-16, before this instance existed). That margin was approved for checkpoint-accuracy replication; reusing it for D3 is a convention, not a D3-validated criterion. A partition whose positive ratio is 1/2 + kappa lets a constant classifier gain kappa accuracy. It applies to R1, which is EXPLORATORY and NON-GATING in this record: R1's sufficient statistic (the label counts) was examined before approval, so R1 is reported descriptively at the exploratory alpha (0.01 within R1) and cannot change the outcome.
tolerance_justification.cross_class_bit: OPERATIONAL FAIL THRESHOLD, not a validated equivalence margin; no PASS or equivalence claim is made at it. Value 2m, where m = MARGIN_FRACTION x (0.5144 - 0.5) = 0.00144 (audit.targets.autond.preregistrations.autond_ii_v2.equivalence_margin, frozen in commit fc46c57 on 2026-10-16, before this instance existed). That margin was approved for checkpoint-accuracy replication; reusing it for D3 is a convention, not a D3-validated criterion. Effect: |P(bit j = 1 | Y=1) - P(bit j = 1 | Y=0)| within one partition. With balanced classes the classifier 'predict 1 iff bit j = 1' has accuracy 1/2 + (p1 - p0)/2, so 2m is the cross-class difference that gives that single-bit classifier an advantage of m. Single coordinate only: many sub-threshold differences can combine in a classifier that uses several bits, so this does NOT bound the 64-bit model. Design resolution at per-hypothesis alpha 0.001/192: 0.00210 (train), 0.00665 (validation/test). FAIL requires a lower bound above 2m.
tolerance_justification.pairwise_tvd: OPERATIONAL FAIL THRESHOLD, not a validated equivalence margin; no PASS or equivalence claim is made at it. Value m, where m = MARGIN_FRACTION x (0.5144 - 0.5) = 0.00144 (audit.targets.autond.preregistrations.autond_ii_v2.equivalence_margin, frozen in commit fc46c57 on 2026-10-16, before this instance existed). That margin was approved for checkpoint-accuracy replication; reusing it for D3 is a convention, not a D3-validated criterion. Effect: total variation distance between the four-cell joint laws of one feature pair in two partitions (A pooled rows, B Y=1 rows, C Y=0 rows). For any classifier f in [0,1] that uses only that pair, |E_P f - E_Q f| <= TVD, so the threshold is a split-consistency shift of m for a pair-restricted classifier. It says nothing about classifiers that use more than two bits, and for A the reading is weaker (class-swapping shifts can cancel in the pooled law). Design resolution at per-hypothesis alpha 0.001/6048: A 0.0064 (train vs held-out) to 0.0097 (validation vs test), B/C 0.0091 to 0.0137; at least four times the threshold and still above it with unlimited validation/test data. These families report simultaneous upper bounds and screen for FAIL only.
